description: The published results of one AI Authority Index™ edition section: each company's Star Chart cell, CRISP™ score where it has one, the five factor readings the edition prints, and how many AI answers named it. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

company.description: Optional: return only rows whose company name contains this.

edition_slug.description: The edition's slug, from list_index_editions, e.g. personal-lending.

section.description: The section key, e.g. personal-lending. Defaults to the edition's first section.

name: get_edition_results
title: Get an edition's results
